task.title: Managing current user options by using the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To retrieve account information or star and unstar repositories in Red Hat Quay, you can use the user API endpoints with an OAuth access token.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: Use the GET /api/v1/user/ endpoint to get user information for the authenticated user.
